name: Tab
description: Piqueray Tab. Extracted from the Figma COMPONENT_SET on DS · Molécules, reviewed and adopted — not authored. Panel and tablist identities are code-only semantics: every Tab belongs to an existing tablist, whose controller owns the bounded roving-focus behavior and keeps exactly one Tab selected/focusable; this contract does not invent a TabList molecule or a panel. Version 2.0.0 is breaking because panelId and tablistId are now required for an accessible Tab relationship.

props.name: panelId
props.description: Code-only id of the panel controlled by this Tab.

props.name: tablistId
props.description: Code-only id of the owning tablist. Its controller supplies the bounded arrow-key roving-focus behavior; exactly one sibling Tab is selected and has tabIndex 0.
